build_rgba_embed: build an RGBA embedding layer from Minecraft block color data with configurable color_io mode
model_filename_from_opts: generate a model checkpoint filename string from training options and optional save directory
color_hash: compute a color hash from Nx4 RGBA tensor values using configurable number of bins
build_SimpleConv: build a SimpleConv 3D convolutional voxel model with word and local variable embeddings
build_AE: build an autoencoder model with encoder-decoder 3D conv layers for voxel block reconstruction
